messages:
alex: Heads-up — we're seeing a regression on console query p95 after the telemetry field rename. Planner shows seq scans on console_metrics for route_id lookups.
maria: Do you have an example query? we can try a partial/sparse index before any backfill.
alex: example: `SELECT count(*) FROM console_metrics WHERE route_id = 'r123' AND ts >= '2026-02-01';` planner -> seq scan. Proposed index: `CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY idx_cmetrics_route_ts ON console_metrics(route_id) INCLUDE (ts) WHERE (deleted = false);`
jonathan: partial index seems right to keep index bloat down. Concern: planner may not use it if route_id cardinality is high for some tenants.
sasha: Partitioning by tenant_id would help long term but is a big migration (new partitioned table + attach). Backfills + FK constraints get messy.
pat: Can we do a nonblocking approach: (1) create index concurrently, (2) push a short-term query hint from the console API for affected routes, (3) parallel matview PoC for heavy reports? avoids table locks.
alex: proposed rollout plan: 1) CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY (partial) 2) instrument console API to emit an optimizer_hint header for 2-4 weeks 3) run targeted backfill window for stale rows 4) monitor p95/cost and revert hint if regressions.
maria: also add telemetry: emit a metric when the query used the new index (explain plan includes Index Scan on idx_cmetrics_route_ts). We can tag slow queries and compare.
jonathan: note: `CONCURRENTLY` needs extra disk space / snapshot. Infra needs to approve ephemeral disk bump on the analytics DB node. Also watch for bloat.
sasha: I'll sync with infra — question: can we do the index creation on a read-replica and then promote the index? postgres doesn't replicate indexes pre-13 well for our setup. Need infra input.
pat: matview tradeoff: cheaper for long-range analytics but not suitable for ad-hoc per-route filters (too coarse unless we keep many mviews). prefer index path for latency-sensitive console queries.
alex: decision (tentative): concurrent partial index + short-term console-side optimizer hint + matview PoC for nightly reports. I'll write a runbook and schedule with infra.
maria: +1
jonathan: +1
sasha: noted, will request disk bump in infra ticket.
deploy-bot: Maintenance request created: MAINT-3321 — Analytics DB index creation (requires ephemeral disk increase). Scheduled tentative window 2026-04-02 01:00 UTC.
alex: thanks — drafting runbook: https://redwood-internal/runbooks/MAINT-3321 (will add pre/post checks, metrics, rollback steps)
pat: owners: alex (runbook + deploy), sasha (infra coordination), maria (telemetry + dashboards), jonathan (console API query hint), pat (QA smoke tests)
alex: I'll post the draft runbook here once done. Please add any blockers. :thumbsup:
